hero.title: Building a Prosperous Ethiopia Together
hero.subtitle: Committed to national unity, economic growth, and the democratic rights of all Ethiopians.

mission.title: Our Guiding Purpose
mission.description: We are dedicated to fostering national unity, promoting economic development, and ensuring the democratic rights of all Ethiopians through transparent governance and inclusive policies.

list.item2: Advance economic policies that benefit all citizens
list.item4: Protect the constitutional rights of all Ethiopians

vision.title: The Ethiopia We Strive For
vision.description: We envision an Ethiopia that is united, prosperous, and democratic - where every citizen enjoys equal opportunities, justice prevails, and our rich cultural heritage is celebrated.
vision.quote: Together we can build an Ethiopia where no one is left behind.

coreValuesSection.title: Our Fundamental Principles
coreValuesSection.subtitle: These values guide every decision we make and every action we take.

dignity.title: Human Dignity
dignity.description: We uphold the inherent worth and rights of every individual.

sovereignty.title: National Sovereignty
sovereignty.description: We protect Ethiopia's independence and territorial integrity.

justice.title: Social Justice
justice.description: We advocate for fair distribution of resources and opportunities.

unity.title: National Unity
unity.description: We celebrate diversity while strengthening our common bonds.

respect.title: Mutual Respect
respect.description: We value all cultures, religions, and ethnic identities.

economy.title: Economic Equity
economy.description: We promote policies that reduce inequality and create shared prosperity.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.description: We maintain the highest ethical standards in all our actions.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: We conduct our work openly and accountably.

political.title: Political Pillars
political.item1: Constitutional democracy and rule of law

principlesSection.title: Our Operational Framework
principlesSection.subtitle: The principles that shape our approach to governance and development.

accountability.title: Accountability
accountability.description: We take responsibility for our actions and decisions at all levels.

governance.title: Good Governance
governance.description: We practice effective, efficient, and participatory administration.

ruleOfLaw.title: Rule of Law
ruleOfLaw.description: We ensure equal application of laws to all citizens.

development.title: Sustainable Development
development.description: We balance economic growth with environmental protection.

evidence.title: Evidence-Based
evidence.description: We make decisions based on research and data.

achievements.title: Our National Achievements
achievements.jobs: Jobs created in the past decade

commissionPurpose.title: Purpose of the Commission
commissionPurpose.description: The commission was established to oversee the implementation of national policies, ensure compliance with constitutional provisions, and mediate between different levels of government to maintain national unity and equitable development.

dutiesSection.title: Duties and Responsibilities
dutiesSection.subtitle: The specific functions assigned to the commission by the constitution and national legislation.

bylaw.title: Draft Bylaws
bylaw.description: Prepare and submit draft laws and regulations necessary for the implementation of constitutional provisions.

quality.title: Ensure Quality
quality.description: Monitor and evaluate the quality of public services delivered to citizens.

assets.title: Protect Assets
assets.description: Safeguard national assets and resources from mismanagement.

memberRights.title: Member Rights
memberRights.description: Protect the rights and benefits of members and staff.

complaints.title: Handle Complaints
complaints.description: Receive and investigate complaints regarding constitutional violations.

guidelines.title: Issue Guidelines
guidelines.description: Prepare and distribute operational guidelines to government institutions.

antiCorruption.title: Anti-Corruption
antiCorruption.description: Implement measures to prevent corruption and maladministration.

investigations.title: Conduct Investigations
investigations.description: Investigate allegations of misconduct in public offices.
